unlock_condition: Unlocked by v3.1 Auto Dream Memory Maintenance exposing trigger, ledger, apply/reject/undo, and audit trail surfaces; still requires completed artifacts before any effectiveness claim.

tasks.title: Duplicate merge suggestion
tasks.prompt: Run the opt-in maintenance loop on a fixture with duplicate memories. Report the merge suggestion and whether provenance is preserved.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must detect duplicate memory and preserve source provenance in a reviewable merge.

tasks.title: Stale truth suggestion
tasks.prompt: Run the opt-in maintenance loop on a fixture with stale truth. Explain the stale suggestion and user-visible rationale.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must suggest staleness without silently deleting current truth.
required_facts: Confirmed truth is not silently removed.
forbidden_claims: No audit trail is needed for stale truth.

tasks.title: Supersede suggestion
tasks.prompt: Run the opt-in maintenance loop on a fixture with old truth and a newer replacement. Report supersede direction and history retention.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must mark old truth historical and keep audit history.
required_facts: Old truth and new truth are identified.
forbidden_claims: Old truth supersedes new truth when evidence says otherwise.

tasks.title: False positive rejection
tasks.prompt: Run the opt-in maintenance loop on a fixture containing a tempting but incorrect suggestion. Reject it and verify truth is unchanged.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must preserve truth after rejecting a false positive.
forbidden_claims: False positives can be hidden from the report.

tasks.title: Undo applied maintenance
tasks.prompt: Apply a maintenance action, then undo it. Report before state, after apply state, after undo state, and ledger entries.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must prove undo changes store state back or clearly report unsupported rollback.
forbidden_claims: Rollback failure is reported as success.

tasks.title: Ledger explainability
tasks.prompt: Inspect a completed maintenance run ledger. Summarize every action, target, rationale, outcome, and failure.
forbidden_claims: Run success can hide failed actions.
